title: Surplus Funds Recovery
uncertainty_note: Editorial sensitivity band, not a statistical interval. Confidence is a supplied classification; independent source review is required.

score_rationale.revenue_potential: Revenue Potential: 22/25. Fee-based recovery has low inventory needs but uneven claim conversion.
score_rationale.profit_margin_potential: Profit Margin Potential: 22/25. Fee-based recovery has low inventory needs but uneven claim conversion.
score_rationale.team_efficiency: Team Efficiency: 18/20. Fee-based recovery has low inventory needs but uneven claim conversion.
score_rationale.startup_accessibility: Startup Accessibility: 12/15. Fee-based recovery has low inventory needs but uneven claim conversion.
score_rationale.automation_potential: Automation Potential: 12/15. Fee-based recovery has low inventory needs but uneven claim conversion.

economics.owner_net_profit_potential: $25,000–$337,500 USD annually, before personal taxes and reinvestment
economics.includes_contractors_note: Headcount includes the working owner and recurring contractors as people, not FTE equivalents. Contractors may be part-time. Scaled scenario adds one employee and one contractor; external vendor workforces are not counted as internal team members.
economics.revenue_basis: Recognized service fees, not client asset value
economics.cost_basis: Annual net margins include operating expenses and non-owner labor; monthly opex is fixed/semi-fixed overhead only. No owner salary is deducted. Capital needs may grow beyond startup range.
economics.estimate_status: Illustrative assumptions; not verified earnings data

conservative.assumption: Illustrative established-operation run rate, not first-year earnings. Margin includes operating costs and non-owner labor; owner labor is not separately compensated. Scale requires additional demand, working capital and delivery capacity.

base_case.assumption: Illustrative established-operation run rate, not first-year earnings. Margin includes operating costs and non-owner labor; owner labor is not separately compensated. Scale requires additional demand, working capital and delivery capacity.

scaled_small_team.assumption: Illustrative established-operation run rate, not first-year earnings. Margin includes operating costs and non-owner labor; owner labor is not separately compensated. Scale requires additional demand, working capital and delivery capacity.

regulatory_notes: Surplus recovery fee caps, assignment validity and waiting periods vary.
Court filings may require licensed counsel.

plays.name: Public-Record & API Intelligence
plays.mechanism: Ingest fragmented county dockets, probate registries, unclaimed property ledgers, and public APIs to surface uncontested claims or high-intent B2B triggers before manual competitors.
inputs: Court & probate dockets
State controller ledgers
Public licensing & entity APIs
workflow: Poll and normalize county/state record releases on an automated cadence
Cross-match entity/kinship/lien records and filter by minimum net fee threshold
Route verified dossiers into compliant outreach and claim execution
metrics: Cost per verified lead
Docket-to-contact latency (hours)
Net recovery / conversion rate

platform_risks.failure_mode: Portal rate-limiting or CAPTCHA gating
platform_risks.trigger: High-frequency automated polling against county or agency web portals
platform_risks.impact: Delayed lead ingestion or temporary IP block on target registry
platform_risks.detection_metric: HTTP 429/403 rate and daily record ingestion delta
platform_risks.fallback: Switch to scheduled bulk FOIA/public-record exports, official data feeds, and low-frequency cached queues

plays.name: Distressed Asset Recovery
plays.mechanism: Locate mispriced, orphaned, or administratively stranded assets—tax-sale overages, unclaimed state funds, dormant judgments, government surplus lots, or distressed micro-businesses—and capture a contingent recovery fee or acquisition spread.
inputs: Tax-sale excess proceeds ledgers
Unclaimed property & judgment dockets
Surplus auction manifests
workflow: Audit statutory fee caps, claim windows, and chain-of-title encumbrances
Execute skip-tracing or asset inspection to confirm net realizable value
Lock in contingent recovery agreements or below-intrinsic buyouts
metrics: Gross spread / contingent fee per case
Claim approval rate
Days from filing to disbursement

platform_risks.failure_mode: Statutory fee-cap compression or administrative hold
platform_risks.trigger: Jurisdiction updates finder fee limits, waiting periods, or filing documentation rules
platform_risks.impact: Reduced net fee margin or extended cash conversion cycle
platform_risks.detection_metric: County/state rejection notice rate and days-to-payout variance
platform_risks.fallback: Diversify across multi-state dockets and use attorney-backed filing partnerships where required

plays.name: State Treasury Escheatment & Unclaimed Corporate Warrant Recovery
plays.mechanism: Ingest state controller/treasury escheatment ledgers and uncashed municipal/corporate warrant registries above $25,000, cross-match corporate officers via Secretary of State filings, and execute statutory recovery agreements for a 10–25% contingent finder fee.
inputs: State controller/treasury escheatment bulk ledgers
Uncashed municipal warrant & vendor-credit registries
Secretary of State officer & FEIN cross-match index
workflow: Filter state unclaimed-property and uncashed-warrant ledgers for high-value corporate and estate accounts exceeding $25,000
Resolve active corporate officers, successor entities, or authorized fiduciaries via SOS and skip-trace databases
Execute state-compliant finder agreements with statutory fee caps and submit notarized claim packages to the treasury administrator
metrics: Average gross warrant/escheatment claim size ($25k+)
Treasury claim approval rate (%)
Days from notarized filing to state disbursement

platform_risks.failure_mode: Statutory finder-fee cap violation or waiting-period rejection
platform_risks.trigger: Charging above state statutory fee limits (e.g., 10% in CA/FL/NY) or soliciting claims during restricted post-escheatment windows
platform_risks.impact: Voided recovery contract, state controller rejection, or administrative penalty
platform_risks.detection_metric: State-by-state fee-cap compliance check (100% pass) and claim rejection notice rate
platform_risks.fallback: Enforce per-state statutory fee caps and waiting-period rules in intake templates and disclose the owner's right to claim directly for free

plays.name: Probate Docket & Pre-Foreclosure Notice-of-Default (NOD) Scraping
plays.mechanism: Parse county probate petitions (Letters Testamentary / Letters of Administration) and daily Notice-of-Default (NOD) filings before national aggregators index them, matching out-of-state personal representatives and distressed owners to licensed probate brokers and cash buyers.
inputs: County probate court register of actions & Letters Testamentary filings
County recorder daily Notice-of-Default (NOD) & Notice-of-Trustee-Sale feeds
Skip-tracing & out-of-state personal-representative matching pipeline
workflow: Extract newly appointed estate personal representatives and real-property inventory from county probate dockets within 24 hours of filing
Cross-match parcel equity and mortgage balances against county assessor and recorder records
Deliver empathetic estate-liquidation checklists, property-preservation referrals, or licensed brokerage introductions
metrics: Docket-to-first-contact speed vs. national data aggregators (days)
Personal-representative response & appointment rate (%)
Commission or referral fee per closed probate/pre-foreclosure parcel

platform_risks.failure_mode: State Foreclosure Consultant Act violations or unlicensed brokerage fee-splitting
platform_risks.trigger: Charging upfront fees to distressed homeowners in NOD or taking unlicensed real-estate commission splits
platform_risks.impact: Voided contracts, treble damages under state foreclosure-protection statutes, or DRE enforcement
platform_risks.detection_metric: 100% licensed broker co-marketing compliance and zero upfront homeowner fee charges
platform_risks.fallback: Monetize strictly via flat-fee marketing/data subscriptions to licensed probate agents or close transactions through a licensed brokerage of record

plays.name: Automated Commercial/Residential Property-Tax Appeal Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Ingest county tax-assessor valuation rolls upon annual notice release, run an automated valuation model (AVM) flagging parcels assessed above comparable neighbor equity ratios, and file bulk administrative tax protests for 30–50% of the first year's verified tax reduction.
inputs: Annual county tax-assessor preliminary valuation rolls & parcel GIS characteristics
Equity-ratio & recent-sale comparable AVM engine
Bulk administrative ARB (Appraisal Review Board) protest filing & hearing pipeline
workflow: Ingest county assessment rolls the day annual valuation notices drop and compute each parcel's assessed-per-sqft percentile against direct neighborhood peers
Mail personalized pre-filled protest postcards showing the owner's exact estimated over-assessment and a QR code to sign a zero-upfront-cost contingency authorization
Auto-generate uniform comparable-equity evidence packets, file bulk administrative protests before the county bar date, and collect 30–50% of Year-1 tax savings
metrics: Protest-window mail-to-signed-authorization conversion %
Percentage of appealed parcels receiving an assessment reduction (65–85% target)
Average net contingency fee per residential ($150–$450) and commercial ($2,000–$15,000) parcel

platform_risks.failure_mode: State property-tax consultant licensing requirements or missed county protest bar dates
platform_risks.trigger: Representing property owners for a fee without required state registration (e.g., Texas TDLR Property Tax Consultant license) or missing the 30/45-day county filing deadline
platform_risks.impact: Rejected bulk filings, administrative fines, or zero contingency revenue for the tax year
platform_risks.detection_metric: 100% licensed tax-agent sign-off in regulated states and T-minus-7-day bulk filing completion
platform_risks.fallback: Partner with licensed local property-tax consultants/attorneys of record in regulated states and automate pre-deadline batch electronic filing

plays.name: HOA Super-Lien & Sub-Threshold Tax-Deed Statutory Redemption Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Price small HOA priority liens and tax-sale interests using jurisdiction-specific priority, notice, and redemption rules; returns depend on enforceable rights, not assumed title extinguishment.
inputs: County tax-sale and HOA lien records
Title report and statutory redemption calendar
Local counsel priority and notice opinion
workflow: 1. Screen small-balance liens against property value, senior debt, and sale eligibility
2. Have local counsel verify priority, service, redemption rights, and purchaser restrictions
3. Bid within a net-recovery ceiling and calendar every payment and notice deadline
4. Reconcile redemption proceeds or pursue counsel-supervised title resolution after rights expire
metrics: Net realized recovery after legal costs
Capital days outstanding
Notice and redemption deadline compliance rate

platform_risks.failure_mode: Sale invalidation or surviving senior lien
platform_risks.trigger: Defective notice or incorrect assumption about statutory lien priority
platform_risks.impact: Loss of expected recovery and extended title litigation
platform_risks.detection_metric: Unresolved title exceptions and notice defects per acquisition
platform_risks.fallback: Suspend bidding, seek available statutory refunds, and limit acquisitions to counsel-cleared interests

plays.name: New-LLC & Recorded-Deed Trigger-Mail Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Ingest daily Secretary of State new-LLC filings and County Recorder new-deed/mortgage recordings to trigger programmatic direct mail via API—replacing illegal government-lookalike poster/deed invoices (which violate 39 U.S.C. § 3001 and state deed-solicitation laws) with high-LTV recurring workplace compliance subscriptions, property-tax appeal contingency offers, and exclusive new-mover/B2B lead monetization.
inputs: Daily Secretary of State new-entity (LLC/Corp) bulk feeds
County Recorder grant/warranty deed & mortgage recording dockets
Programmatic print-and-mail API (Lob / PostGrid) + QR intake bridge
workflow: Pull daily new-LLC formations (filtering for employer/commercial NAICS or multi-member filings) and newly recorded residential deeds with purchase price and loan metadata
Dispatch transparent, non-governmental trigger mailers within 24–48 hours of filing with personalized QR codes pre-populating entity or parcel data

Monetize new LLCs via recurring annual labor-poster/registered-agent compliance memberships and B2B partner referrals; monetize new deeds via contingency property-tax appeal filings or high-ticket homeowner lead sales
metrics: Filing-to-mailbox latency (hours)
QR scan & intake conversion % per 1,000 mailers
Annualized LTV / net revenue per mailed piece

platform_risks.failure_mode: USPS 39 U.S.C. § 3001(h)-(i) mail-stop order, State AG UDAP enforcement, or payment-processor freeze
platform_risks.trigger: Styling mailers as fake government penalty notices, invoices, or charging $89-$195 solely for a $3 public deed copy without statutory disclaimers
platform_risks.impact: Civil restitution penalties, merchant account termination, and 30%+ chargeback rates
platform_risks.detection_metric: Refund/chargeback ratio >1% and customer support inquiries mistaking the mailer for a government agency
platform_risks.fallback: Use unambiguous private commercial branding, never mimic government seals or citation numbers, and sell genuine value-add subscriptions (annual compliance updates, tax-assessment appeals, or B2B services)

plays.name: Identity-Graph Pixel & Search-Intent Deanonymization
plays.mechanism: Deploy first-party CNAME identity-resolution pixels and pre-click search/bidstream intent feeds (syncing visitor IP/device hashes against publisher co-op SHA-256 rainbow tables and property/B2B graphs) to resolve 35–55% of anonymous bouncing search visitors into verified names, emails, LinkedIn profiles, and physical home addresses.
inputs: First-party CNAME identity-resolution pixel & Google Ads ValueTrack ({keyword}) URL tags
Publisher co-op SHA-256 HEM spine + County Assessor / B2B LinkedIn enrichment graph
Automated physical postcard API (Lob / PostGrid), B2B Slack routing, & Custom Audience sync
workflow: Geo-fence pixel execution at the CDN edge (US-only, excluding EU/UK GDPR traffic) and capture exact referring search keywords via ValueTrack parameters
Resolve anonymous bouncing visitors against the identity spine within 200ms to append homeowner address, work email, and LinkedIn URL
Route resolved B2B executives to instant Slack/LinkedIn warm outreach, trigger physical next-day postcards to resolved homeowner addresses, and sync SHA-256 hashes into Meta/Google Custom Audiences
metrics: Anonymous visitor-to-identity match rate (35–55% target)
Cost per resolved identity ($0.10–$0.25) vs. net recovered revenue per 1,000 bounces
Postcard & B2B LinkedIn intercept conversion rate (%)

platform_risks.failure_mode: Primary email domain blacklisting (>0.3% spam complaint rate) or California CIPA / state privacy demand letters
platform_risks.trigger: Blasting cold consumer Gmail addresses from primary brand domains saying 'we saw you on our site' or firing third-party pixels without geo-fencing/consent notice
platform_risks.impact: Google Workspace / ESP domain suspension or statutory privacy settlement costs
platform_risks.detection_metric: Postmaster Tools spam rate >0.1%, bounce rate >2%, and edge geo-fence block verification
platform_risks.fallback: Never cold-email unconsented consumer Gmail addresses from primary domains; monetize consumer matches strictly via CAN-SPAM-exempt physical trigger mail and SHA-256 ad-audience sync, and enforce US-only edge geo-gating

plays.name: Programmatic 'Alternative To / Pricing / Cancel' Intent Hijacking
plays.mechanism: Generate programmatic nominative-fair-use comparison matrices, live fee calculators, and migration guides targeting bottom-of-funnel '[Competitor] pricing', '[Competitor] cancel', and '[Competitor] vs [Offer]' queries to intercept buyers with 10–18% conversion rates.
inputs: Competitor pricing tiers, hidden-fee schedules, & cancellation friction data
Bottom-of-funnel '[Brand] pricing / alternative / vs' keyword taxonomy
Interactive side-by-side TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) switching calculator
workflow: Ingest verified public pricing, contract lock-in terms, and fee schedules across 100+ incumbent providers in the target vertical
Publish objective, factual side-by-side comparison matrices and switching calculators under nominative fair use
Offer a 1-click migration concierge or instant savings quote that routes high-intent switchers into owned SaaS, agency, or high-ticket affiliate offers
metrics: Bottom-of-funnel visitor-to-lead conversion % (10–18% target)
Earnings per click (EPC) on switching-intent queries
Organic top-3 SERP share across '[Competitor] pricing/alternative' clusters

platform_risks.failure_mode: UDRP trademark complaint, DMCA notice, or false-advertising cease-and-desist
platform_risks.trigger: Impersonating competitor login pages, using trademarked logos deceptively, or publishing fabricated competitor pricing
platform_risks.impact: Page takedown demand or affiliate partner account review
platform_risks.detection_metric: Quarterly pricing fact-check audit log and legal/compliance inbox alerts
platform_risks.fallback: Rely strictly on nominative fair use (text-only brand names, timestamped public pricing citations, and zero logo spoofing)

plays.name: Social-to-Search Ad Feed & Ping-Post Lead Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Buy $0.05–$0.12 curiosity clicks on Meta, TikTok, NewsBreak, and native ad networks and route them through a 4-question qualification bridge—replacing fragile $1.50 RSOC/AFD search-feed clicks with direct $45–$180 Ping-Post lead auctions.
inputs: Low-CPC social/native ad hooks ($0.05–$0.12 CPC)
Fast 4-question conditional qualification quiz + TCPA consent capture
Real-time Ping-Post lead distribution engine (Boberdoo / Leadspedia / Phonexa) + RSOC downsell feed
workflow: Acquire low-cost social and native clicks using compliant consumer-benefit hooks (tax appeals, solar rebates, insurance audits, surplus claims)
Pre-qualify zip code, homeowner/business status, and urgency inside a zero-friction 4-step quiz bridge
Auction verified exclusive leads in real time via Ping-Post for $45–$180/lead and monetize non-qualifying traffic via compliant secondary search/affiliate offers
metrics: Effective media cost per qualified lead (CPL) vs. Ping-Post auction payout
Ping-to-Post acceptance rate (%) and sub-500ms auction response time
Net arbitrage margin after ad spend and buyer returns

platform_risks.failure_mode: Ad-account ban, RSOC/AFD feed termination, or TCPA consent challenge
platform_risks.trigger: Using fake 'government stimulus' ad bait, forcing accidental ad clicks, or selling leads without one-to-one TCPA consent logs
platform_risks.impact: Ad account suspension, feed clawbacks, or buyer lead rejections
platform_risks.detection_metric: Ad disapproval rate, buyer return rate >5%, and TrustedForm/Jornaya certificate match rate (100% required)
platform_risks.fallback: Enforce 100% factual ad hooks, log cryptographic TrustedForm/Jornaya session certificates on every form submit, and diversify across 5+ direct lead buyers
